items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: it was a James Brown thing

ctx.x: I guess you know. I was kind of like blessed I think as far as the range goes you know. I think that was kind of a natural gift I got to be able to play that altissimo register. So it never was like difficult for me, playing a bunch of charts some of them are screamers and some of them were not so bad, so it leveled out, and I could do it all. I could cover it.

There are certain tunes that almost require an answer. Musically, yesterday I got out a chart I had written for my sax ensemble and it was a James Brown thing and before we played it I said, all right remember these are college aged students, I said “All right everybody, give me the proper response” and I said, [sings] “I feel good” and they all went [scats]. So I’m going to try one out on you, if I sing “Sweet Caroline.” —
